_comment: EDIT THIS FILE to control which appointments can be booked.
It is read by the booking page AND by the backend on the LRZ site, so it is the single source of truth.
All times are local time in Europe/Berlin (CET in winter, CEST in summer - handled automatically).
Commit and push; the change is live within a minute or two.
weekly    : recurring hours per weekday, as [start, end] windows (24h clock). Omit a day to offer nothing.
extra     : additional windows on specific dates, e.g. a one-off Friday.
blocked   : dates with no appointments at all (holidays, travel), overriding 'weekly'.
leadHours : nothing can be requested less than this many hours from now.
horizonDays: nothing can be requested more than this many days ahead.
holdHours : how long a pending (not yet approved) request keeps its slot before it is released.
topics    : what the requester chooses from. 'minutes' sets the appointment length for that topic;
slots are offered at that spacing inside each window (a 45-min topic in 10:00-12:00 gives 10:00 and 10:45).
'id' is stored with the booking - keep it stable once in use; change the labels freely.
